name: Fashion Komyushou-kun to Business Bocchi-chan Z: Fuyu no Cinderella
original_name: ファッションコミュ障くんとビジネスボッチちゃんゼット　冬のシンデレラ
source:
December, the month in which the Heisei Era ended, and the new Reiwa era began.

In the Heisei era, the Reiwa era, and even today, a certain convenience store remains open 24/7/365. 

All the part-time workers have been replaced, leaving only the manager to continue working as usual. 

Last month, another part-timer quit, and this month, a new part-timer has joined.

The new part-timer, who is about one year older than the manager, seems to be part of Gen Z.

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ417302.html]DLsite[/url]]
